v2HardeningRepairs.behavior: A requested full Omega/Omega_crit=0.4 rotating-family coordinate below 1.8 solar masses now returns RESEARCH_REQUIRED instead of being treated as a globally independent rotation grid axis. The published zero/ramp/full mass convention is recorded explicitly and exact downloaded-track metadata remains required.

Arbitrary threshold-set IDs/hashes can no longer silently inherit numeric Jeans-regime thresholds. Every non-synthetic set must provide explicit numeric boundaries; only the explicitly named synthetic regression fixture may use test defaults.

nusseltRayleighScenario now fails closed without critical-Rayleigh parameter-set provenance and at/below declared onset. Unnormalized scaling shape may still be inspected diagnostically but physicalNusseltAuthorized remains false. The 200-300 Myr lag relation is explicitly only a context-bound unnormalized sensitivity shape.
